Ferrari.2026Philosophy: High rake concept with aggressive active aero deployment. Ferrari bet big on the new regulations matching their design philosophy. Massive power unit investment.
2026Strengths: Power unit massive upgrade — best in field potentially
Active aero suits their high-rake concept
Two world class drivers — best lineup on grid
2026Weaknesses: Historically reliability concerns at worst moments
Managing two #1 drivers without team orders controversy
Ferrari.history: Most storied team in F1 history. 16 constructors titles. Tifosi fanbase worldwide. Founded by Enzo Ferrari.
Ferrari.2026narrative: The dream team — Hamilton + Leclerc. Either wins the title this year or it's a disaster. All eyes on Maranello.

McLaren.2026Philosophy: Efficient aero, strong mechanical platform. Conservative approach to active aero implementation. Focus on race pace over qualifying.
2026Strengths: Two young hungry drivers with no ego battles
Strong 2024-2025 momentum — best chassis in field
McLaren.history: Senna and Prost era. 8 championships. Massive revival since 2023 after decade in wilderness.
McLaren.2026narrative: The challenger. If Red Bull stumbles, McLaren is ready. Norris vs Piastri could be the title fight.

Mercedes.2026Philosophy: Zero-pod concept evolved. Heavy investment in 2026 power unit development — homologated advantage.
2026Strengths: Potentially best power unit in 2026 — they wrote the rules
Mercedes.history: Dominant 2014-2021. Hamilton era. 8 championships in a row. Greatest team dynasty in modern F1.
Mercedes.2026narrative: Rebuilding after Hamilton left. Can Antonelli be the next superstar? Russell needs to step up.

Red Bull.2026Philosophy: Aggressive downforce philosophy. Struggling to adapt active aero concept to their design DNA.
2026Strengths: Verstappen is Verstappen — can carry an average car
Deep engineering talent from dominant era
2026Weaknesses: Active aero suits rivals more than their philosophy
Honda PU may not be best in class
Red Bull.2026narrative: First time in years they look genuinely beatable. Can Verstappen carry them again?

Aston Martin.2026form: Struggling most in testing. Alonso says they have the most work to do of any team.
Aston Martin.2026narrative: Lawrence Stroll's billions haven't bought competitiveness in 2026 yet. Alonso's patience being tested.

Alpine.2026narrative: French manufacturer fighting for midfield respectability. Gasly their best hope.

Williams.2026form: Surprisingly competitive in testing. Most laps completed in Test 1. Dark horse of 2026.
Williams.2026narrative: Williams renaissance? Sainz joining might be the catalyst for their return to relevance.

Haas.2026narrative: American team with Ferrari power — can they crack the top 5 consistently?

Audi.notable: Brand new manufacturer entry in 2026. Bought Sauber/Alfa Romeo entry. Massive investment.
Audi.2026narrative: German engineering giant enters F1. Huge investment but starting from scratch. Watch this space.

Cadillac.notable: American manufacturer entry approved after long FIA battle. 11th team on grid. Historic moment.
Cadillac.2026narrative: America's own F1 team finally on the grid. Underdogs but historic. Perez their experienced anchor.

Racing Bulls.2026narrative: Red Bull's junior team — stepping stone for future stars. Tsunoda their experienced head.
